mapper.select: SELECT id, status FROM ph_warehouse WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.id, s.batch_id, s.location_id, s.drug_id, s.qty, s.qty_frozen FROM ph_inv_location_stock s JOIN ph_inv_batch b ON b.id = s.batch_id AND b.tenant_id = s.tenant_id WHERE s.batch_id = #{batchId} AND s.location_id = #{locationId} AND s.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND b.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND s.deleted = b'0' AND b.deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) FROM ph_inv_location_stock s JOIN ph_inv_batch b ON b.id = s.batch_id AND b.tenant_id = s.tenant_id WHERE s.location_id = #{locationId} AND s.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND b.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND s.deleted = b'0' AND b.deleted = b'0'

SELECT batch_id, location_id, in_qty, out_qty FROM ph_inv_flow WHERE tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND deleted = b'0' AND flow_type = 60 AND biz_type = 8 AND biz_no = #{bizNo} AND biz_line_id = #{bizLineId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE ph_inv_location_stock SET qty = qty - #{qty}, updater = #{operator}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND deleted = b'0' AND qty - qty_frozen >= #{qty}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ph_inv_location_stock (tenant_id, batch_id, location_id, drug_id, qty, qty_frozen, creator, updater) VALUES (#{scope.tenantId}, #{batchId}, #{locationId}, #{drugId}, 0, 0, #{operator}, #{operator}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id)
mapper.update: UPDATE ph_inv_location_stock SET qty = qty + #{qty}, updater = #{operator}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND deleted = b'0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ph_inv_flow (tenant_id, store_id, batch_id, drug_id, batch_no, flow_type, in_qty, out_qty, balance_qty, biz_type, biz_no, biz_line_id, flow_time, operator, creator, updater, location_id, frozen_delta, unit_cost) VALUES (#{scope.tenantId}, #{scope.storeId}, #{flow.batchId}, #{flow.drugId}, #{flow.batchNo}, 60, #{flow.inQty}, #{flow.outQty}, #{flow.balanceQty}, 8, #{flow.bizNo}, #{flow.bizLineId}, #{flow.flowTime}, #{flow.operator}, #{flow.operator}, #{flow.operator}, #{flow.locationId}, 0, #{flow.unitCost})
